scope: Independent saved-source launcher/build/protocol review; no science imports/model evaluation/training/network; mock process tests only
approval_scope_note: Dispatch/freeze review approved afterR1/R2 fixes and final60-arm static bundle audit. Scientific adapter source review remains separately provided by ROOT_SOURCE_REVIEW.json. Actual resource receipt required before remote execution.

findings.finding: approved_for_bounded_screen boolean is accepted without comparing the reviewed scientific/source hashes to current files before copying. Review can become stale as adapters are still edited.
findings.action: Require all bundled reviewed executable and scientific metadata hashes to match the independent review snapshot before copying/freezing; retain static dry-run and manifest hash after assembly.
findings.resolution: Builder verifies every reviewed hash beforecopy; final copied executable/source bytes independently matched to reviewed originals.

findings.finding: CPU quotas include v1 fallback, but available-memory limit only reads cgroup-v2 memory.max/current. On v1,/proc/meminfo may describe host memory rather than task allowance.
findings.action: Implement v1 memory.limit_in_bytes/usage_in_bytes fallback or fail closed outside verified cgroup-v2 scope; remote admission receipt still required.
findings.resolution: Added cgroup-v1 memory.limit_in_bytes and memory.usage_in_bytes fallback, taking min with host available memory.

limitations: Actual remote64CPU allocation/memory/disk not checked by this reviewer; launcher must record resources before execution
60-worker concurrent peak memory/throughput not benchmarked;24GiB is a declared admission floor
180s diagnostic budget can leave width256 required states unmeasured; preserve missing/censoring labels
Scientific adapter correctness is covered by the separate frozen root/source reviews, not this dispatcher review
